caption: The drawing is a monochrome illustration rendered in black ink on a light, possibly off-white background. In the foreground, there are two tall iron gateposts, each topped with a large, angular gas lamp that features a pointed cap. The posts are rectangular in shape with ornate, decorative patterns of scrolls and medallions running vertically. Between the posts is a barred iron gate with evenly spaced vertical bars and a horizontal bar near the middle, flanked on each side by sections of matching iron fencing of similar design with pointed finials at the top. The base beneath the gateposts consists of a stone or concrete platform with visible lines suggesting paving stones. In the background stands a building with two stories, three rectangular windows with shutters or divided panes visible on each floor, and wrought-iron railings with decorative floral patterns running along the upper level. The drawing style relies on cross-hatching and line work for shading and detail. Below the image, the text “IRON GATE and POSTS” is written in capital letters.
title: Cast Iron Gate and Fence
